website kaise use karein: Home page par ja kar search bar use karein. Categories browse kar sakte hain ya product name type kar ke search kar sakte hain.
account kaise banayein: Sign up button par click karein, email/phone daal ke verification karein. Password set kar ke account ban jayega.
login kaise karein: Login page par ja kar email/phone aur password daal ke 'Sign In' button dabayein.
password bhool gaye hain kya karein: 'Forgot Password' par click karein, email/phone pe reset link aayega. Naya password set kar sakte hain.
offer ka code kahan enter karein: Checkout page mein 'Apply Coupon' box hota hai. Wahan code enter kar ke apply karein.
ye product available hai: Product page par 'In Stock' status dikhata hai. Agar nahi hai to 'Notify Me' option use kar sakte hain.
size chart kahan hai: Product images ke neeche 'Size Guide' ka button hota hai. Wahan se measurements dekh sakte hain.
original product hai ya duplicate: Hum sirf 100% authentic products bechte hain. Har product ka warranty card milta hai.
color screen se alag to nahi hoga: Colors thoda vary kar sakte hain due to screen settings. Original color ke liye product description check karein.
return policy kya hai: 15 din ke andar unused products return kar sakte hain. Original packaging ke saath return karna zaroori hai.
cash on delivery cod hai: Haan, ₹5000 tak ke orders ke liye COD available hai. Zyada amount ke liye online payment karna hoga.
emi option hai: Haan, ₹5000 se above orders par select banks ke credit cards se EMI available hai.
discount kaise milega: Coupons apply karein ya 'Offers' section check karein. Festival sales mein extra discounts milte hain.
refund kitne din mein milega: Return approve hone ke 5-7 working days mein refund bank/wallet mein credit ho jata hai.
payment fail ho gayi kya karein: Internet connection check karein, phir dobara try karein. Agar phir fail ho to dusra payment method use karein.
delivery kitne din mein hogi: Standard delivery 3-5 working days. Express delivery 1-2 days (extra ₹99 charge).
order ka status kaise check karein: 'My Orders' section mein ja kar tracking ID par click karein. Live status dikhayega.
address change kar sakte hain: Order ship hone se pehle address change kar sakte hain. 'Order Details' mein edit option hota hai.
delivery free hai: Haan, ₹999 se above orders ke liye free delivery hai. Chhote orders par ₹49 charge hota hai.
order cancel kaise karein: 'My Orders' mein ja kar 'Cancel' button dabayein. 24 hours ke andar cancel ho sakta hai.
product pasand nahi aya return kaise kar: 'My Orders' mein return request bhejein. Hum pickup ka arrange karenge.
wrong item aya hai kya karein: Customer care ko call karein (1800-123-4567) ya order ID ke saath complaint register karein.
damaged product mila replacement kaise m: Delivery boy ko damage dikha kar refuse karein. Naya product ship kar denge.
return ka pickup kab aayega: Return request approve hone ke 2-3 working days mein pickup ho jata hai.
complain kaise register karein: Helpline (1800-123-4567) par call karein ya 'Contact Us' page se email karein.
customer care number kya hai: 24/7 helpline: 1800-123-4567 (9AM-9PM). WhatsApp support bhi available hai.
live chat ka option hai: Haan, website ke right corner par 'Chat Now' button par click karein.
email par reply kitne din mein aayega: 24-48 working hours mein reply mil jata hai. Urgent cases ke liye call karein.
store ka address kya hai: BuyZaar Store, MG Road, Bangalore. Timing: 10AM-9PM (Monday-Sunday).
whatsapp support hai: Haan, +91 9876543210 par 'Hi' message bhej kar WhatsApp support le sakte hain.
